## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn verify` passes locally (this includes the license-header check)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by a test
- [ ] Public API additions carry javadoc
- [ ] Code follows the style in CONTRIBUTING.md (2-space indent, 120 columns)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`, if this is user-visible
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `docs/` and `README.md` where relevant
